This feels right. When I clicked "Recipes" in the sidebar, the list narrowed down to just the two recipe bookmarks and the heading told me "2 bookmarks labeled Recipes," so it's obvious what I'm looking at. That's exactly the "click a label, see just those" experience I wanted.

Having the labels sitting in the sidebar with a count next to each one works well for me — they're easy to spot, and the counts give me a nice sense of what's in each pile before I even click. Placement's good.

Two things I want to make sure of, since they're part of using labels day to day:

- How do I actually put a label on a bookmark in the first place? I'd want to add one (or more than one) to an item, and when I start typing a label I already use, I'd expect it to suggest the existing one so I don't accidentally create a slightly-different duplicate.
- Can a single bookmark carry more than one label? Some things are both "work" and "recipes" for me, and I'd want it to show up under either.

Can you show me adding labels to a bookmark?
